product.name: OmniAI Document Processing API
product.description: An API-driven platform that extracts and structures data from complex documents including text, tables, and forms for integration into workflows.

product.name: OmniAI Bulk Document Extraction
product.description: A feature enabling large-scale automated extraction of data from bulk document sets to support high-volume workflows.

product.name: OmniAI Industry-Specific Document Solutions
product.description: Pre-configured extraction solutions tailored to specific industries like finance, real estate, lending, and KYB for automating document workflows.

product.name: OmniAI Document OCR and Classification
product.description: Optical character recognition and document classification technology that converts scanned and machine-readable documents into structured data.

product.name: OmniAI Security and Privacy Features
product.description: Security and privacy controls including private cloud hosting, role-based access, audit logs, and encryption to protect document data.

product.name: Monumint AI agent platform
product.description: A platform that provides autonomous conversational AI agents to automate complex workflows for banks and financial institutions.
